newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Active Tunis bourse closes 0.21 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Active Tunis bourse closes 0.21 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.21 percent in active trade boosted by deals on a leasing firm, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 498.07 from 499.12 points on Tuesday.
Total volume was 4.26 million dinars against 1.39 million over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 3.74 million dinars from 570,411 on Tuesday with 120,193 shares changing hands.
Most of the trade was on leasing firm Tunisie Leasing with 108,148 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 32 dinars through four contracts, bourse sources said.
Banque Nationale Agricole fell 0.9 dinar to 29.1 dinars.
Real estate firm SIMPAR was down 0.76 dinar to 24.64. Retail stores Monoprix slid 0.3 dinar to 37.5 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF edged lower 0.3 dinar to 17 with 3,145 shares changing hands.
BTEI bank declined 0.2 dinar to 22.6 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.2 dinar to 19. UBCI bank eased 0.2 dinar to 49.98 dinars.
Insurance company ASTREE rose 0.68 dinar to 23.36 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
